Sovereign voice barge-in = user barges in mid-sentence. Sovereign AI: (1) detects barge-in, (2) stops, (3) listens. Sovereign barge-in respects Sovereignty pillar.
Sovereign voice end-of-turn = sovereign AI knows when user is done. Detection: silence, prosody, semantic. Sovereign end-of-turn is auditable, sovereign-defined.
